description: `cli package publish --help` prints its topic with manifest exit codes.

stdout.text:
Usage: prose [GLOBAL OPTIONS] cli package publish <FILE|DIR> --organization <ORG> --name <NAME> --version <VERSION> [--public] [--json]

Publish one file, or a directory with prose-package.json listing its files, exports
and pinned dependencies. Private is the default.

Arguments:
  FILE|DIR                    The file or package directory to publish.

Options:
  --organization ORG          Organization that owns the package. Required.
  --name NAME                 Package name. Required.
  --version VERSION           Exact version to publish. Required.
  --public                    Make the version publicly discoverable.
  --json                      Print one JSON result; the same as the global --output json.
  --help                      Show help for this command.

Examples:
  prose cli package publish my-package --organization acme --name tool --version 1.0.0 --json

Output: openprose.package-operation/1 (--json).
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 invalid invocation or configuration; 10 service, credential or registry error; 24 interrupted.
